description: Fetch a marketplace opportunity. Use the id or url from list_opportunities (published marketplace ids differ from opportunity ids on my_participation). Resolves the marketplace menu path automatically; pass path to override.

event.description: B2match event URL, slug/euid, or numeric event id.

opportunity_id.description: Published opportunity id or URL from list_opportunities.

path.description: Optional event menu path (e.g. /components/<id>) from get_event navigation; omit to resolve it automatically.

name: get_opportunity
title: Get B2match opportunity
